insights.title: Fewer downpours than before
insights.body: Days with 20 mm or more of rain went from about 30 to 21 a year (first vs last 10 years).

insights.title: Dry spells are getting longer
insights.body: The longest run of days without rain went from about 46 to 59 days. Short, drought-tolerant crops lower the risk.

insights.title: Best-matched crops for this area
insights.body: Rubber, Oil palm and Cashew score highest on climate, water and soil fit.

outlook.method: Theil-Sen trend + Mann-Kendall test on 2001-2024 yearly data, extended to 2035 with an 80% prediction range. Where there is no clear trend, the 2001-2024 average is projected. Statistical extrapolation, not a climate-model forecast.

consequences.headline: Dry spells stretching to about 70 days
consequences.detail: The longest run without rain is growing from about 53 days. Seedlings sown on the first rains, and crops in flower, can die in a long gap.
consequences.action: Wait until the rains are steady before sowing; choose short, drought-tolerant varieties.

consequences.headline: In a dry year, rain can drop to about 1,362 mm
consequences.detail: That is 23% below the 1,762 mm average; about 1 year in 10 is this dry or worse.
consequences.action: Keep a drought-tolerant crop in the plan as insurance.
